title: NEAT-AI Creature Export
description: Schema for the NEAT-AI creature export (snapshot) format. This format is used for serialising creatures to JSON for persistence, visualisation (e.g. NEAT-AI-Explore), and inter-process communication. Validate with: import Ajv from 'ajv'; const ajv = new Ajv(); const validate = ajv.compile(schema); validate(snapshot);

semanticVersion.description: Semantic version of the creature format (e.g. '1.0.0'). Used for migration and upgrade logic.

forwardOnly.description: When true, indicates a feed-forward topology with no recurrent (self-loop or backward) connections.

input.description: Number of input neurons in the creature. Input neurons are implicit and not listed in the neurons array.

output.description: Number of output neurons in the creature.

neurons.description: Array of non-input neurons (hidden, output, and constant). Input neurons are implicit based on the 'input' count.

synapses.description: Array of connections between neurons, each carrying a weight.

tags.description: Optional metadata tags attached to the creature (e.g. error, score, training approach).

memetic.description: Optional memetic evolution state tracking weights, biases, and ancestry across generations.

neuron.description: A non-input neuron in the creature network.

type.description: The role of this neuron: 'hidden' for intermediate processing, 'output' for final results, 'constant' for fixed-value bias neurons.

uuid.description: Unique identifier for the neuron. Output neurons use 'output-N' format; hidden/constant neurons use UUIDs or descriptive names.

bias.description: Bias value added to the neuron's weighted input sum before the activation function is applied.

squash.description: Activation (squash) function name applied to this neuron (e.g. 'LOGISTIC', 'ReLU6', 'TANH', 'IF', 'GAUSSIAN', 'SELU'). Omitted when using the default activation.

tags.description: Optional metadata tags attached to this neuron.

synapse.description: A weighted connection between two neurons in the creature network.

fromUUID.description: UUID of the source (pre-synaptic) neuron. Input neurons use 'input-N' format.

weight.description: Connection weight multiplied with the source neuron's output.

type.description: Optional constraint on the synapse: 'positive' clamps weight >= 0, 'negative' clamps weight <= 0, 'condition' marks a conditional input for IF-type neurons.

tags.description: Optional metadata tags attached to this synapse.

tag.description: A name-value metadata pair used to annotate creatures, neurons, or synapses.

value.description: Tag value as a string. Numeric values are stored as their string representation.

memeticWeight.description: A single weight record in the memetic evolution state.

toUUID.description: UUID of the destination neuron for this weight.

weight.description: The weight value at this generation.

memeticAncestorSnapshot.description: A snapshot of memetic state from a previous generation, used to track evolution of weights and biases.

generation.description: The generation number when this snapshot was taken.

weights.description: Weight state at this generation, keyed by source neuron UUID.

biases.description: Bias state at this generation, keyed by neuron UUID.

memeticWeights.description: Map of source neuron UUID to an array of weight records.

memeticBiases.description: Map of neuron UUID to its bias value at a given generation.

memetic.description: Memetic evolution state tracking the current generation's weights and biases, plus an optional ancestry buffer.

generation.description: Current generation number for memetic evolution.

weights.description: Current weight state, keyed by source neuron UUID.

biases.description: Current bias state, keyed by neuron UUID.

ancestry.description: Optional circular buffer of ancestor snapshots, ordered from most recent to oldest. Limited to 3 entries by default.
